title: Baruapepe (Theme 4: Saa na majira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the parts of an email (Kwa, Kichwa, salamu, ujumbe, hitimisho, kiambatisho) and what each holds.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the parts of a friendly letter.
floor.question: Barua huanza na nini?

representations: an email screen on the board

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels the parts of an email screen.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Anwani ya mpokeaji kwenye baruapepe huandikwa wapi?" Kwa nini "Kona ya juu kulia" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Baruapepe ina sehemu ya "Kwa" kwa anwani ya mpokeaji, na sehemu ya mada. Si kama barua ya karatasi yenye anwani kona.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sehemu ya mada huandikwa nini?" Kwa nini "Ujumbe wote" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mada ni kichwa kifupi cha baruapepe. Ujumbe wote huandikwa katika mwili wa baruapepe.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Baruapepe huisha na nini?" Kwa nini "Salamu ya mwanzo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mpangilio wa baruapepe: anayepokea, mada, salamu, ujumbe, hitimisho, jina la mwandishi.
Faili au picha hutumwa kama kiambatisho kwa kubonyeza alama ya pini.

checks.question: Kisanduku cha "Kichwa" ni cha nini?
checks.answer: kueleza ujumbe unahusu nini kwa ufupi

skills.key_step: The child plans baruapepe before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Saa ya Mkutano wa Klabu".

misconceptions.ask: Mpokeaji ataona nini kwanza kwenye sanduku lake?
misconceptions.repair: Kichwa cha baruapepe ni maneno machache yanayoeleza ujumbe unahusu nini.

listen_for: S.L.P. 120, Nakuru, na tarehe juu kulia
misconceptions.repair: Baruapepe haina anwani ya posta wala tarehe juu; kifaa huziweka chenyewe.

misconceptions.ask: Anwani ya baruapepe ina alama gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kisanduku cha "Kwa" huandikwa anwani ya baruapepe ya mpokeaji, yenye @.

misconceptions.ask: Maneno haya yangeeleweka na kila mtu?
misconceptions.repair: Baruapepe huandikwa kwa lugha sahihi, na humalizika kwa hitimisho na jina.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika baruapepe kuhusu "Saa ya Mkutano wa Klabu"?
Baruapepe ina sehemu zipi?
checks.answer: anwani au kichwa, salamu, ujumbe, hitimisho
